dishes.name: Çine köftesi
dishes.desc: A meatball dish from the Çine district, traditionally eaten with yayık ayranı, churned buttermilk. A specialty of the Büyük Menderes valley.

dishes.name: Çingene pilavı
dishes.desc: Despite the name, a rice-free dish of çökelek curd cheese, tomato, pepper, cucumber, parsley, onion and thyme dressed with olive oil. Eaten at any meal in Aydın.

dishes.name: Yuvarlama
dishes.desc: Fried balls of minced meat, onion, egg and spices, simmered in butter and water, served with strained yogurt and red pepper butter. An Aydın home dish.

dishes.name: Söke çöp şiş
dishes.desc: Small skewers of meat from the town of Söke, named in food guides as the town's signature dish alongside its tahinli pide.

dishes.name: Aydın keşkek
dishes.desc: Wheat and chicken or lamb cooked with butter and topped with butter and red pepper sauce. Served at weddings and circumcision celebrations.
